hardinessNote: Half-hardy, approximately −5 to 1°C (RHS 388342); best in mild or coastal gardens, or shelter it in winter.
foliage: evergreen; narrow leaves striped green and cream, edged pink, flushing deep pink-red in cold weather
visual: Cream-striped leaves edged hot pink, richest pink-red in winter · compact rounded evergreen · short lilac flower spikes in summer
water: Water regularly until established; pots need watering in dry spells. Never leave it standing wet in winter.
soilWarning: Cold, wet winter soil kills it
prune: Little needed. Trim lightly after flowering to keep it compact; cut out any shoots that revert to plain green.
resilience: Copes with salt wind on the coast; winter colour is best in sun. Hard frost and cold wet soil damage it. Pests: aphids; leaf spot and downy mildew.
uses: Patio pots · winter colour · front of borders · coastal gardens · bees on the flowers
cvs: 'Emerald Gem' – compact plain green bun · 'Rhubarb Crumble' – pink-flushed foliage · 'Red Edge' – grey leaves edged red
sources: RHS 388342, Veronica 'Heartbreaker' (H/v), syn. Hebe 'Heartbreaker' PBR (RHS 195620): H3, 0.5–1 m × 0.5–1 m in 5–10 years; description to 60 cm; Plants for Pollinators (search snippets)
Gates Garden Centre, Gardening Express, Ashridge, Promesse de Fleurs: cream-edged leaves turning pink-red in winter, mauve-lilac flowers in summer, about 60 cm
uncertain: name: Oscar's label reads Hebe 'Heartbreaker'; the RHS now files it as Veronica 'Heartbreaker'. The label's name is kept, as on the deck's other Hebe cards.
size: RHS ultimate 0.5–1 m × 0.5–1 m; its own description and retailers say about 60 cm.
peak: Jan-Dec for the evergreen foliage it is sold on; flowers in summer (retailers give May–Jul or Jul–Aug).
toxicity: no RHS warning and no ASPCA listing found for Hebe; one Gardeners' World page flags Hebe 'Paula' unclearly. 'No known hazard' is the absence of a listing. [Unverified]
compliance: PBR from the RHS name suffix; grant number not found.
ratings, aspect, water and prune: judged from the deck's sibling Hebe cards, not sourced.
